briefing.headline: OpenAI o4 and xAI Grok-4 push frontier capabilities as compute race accelerates

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: The AGI race has intensified with multiple frontier labs releasing advanced models this month. Investment remains robust while regulatory scrutiny grows over safety and security risks.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI released o4 with enhanced reasoning; xAI launched Grok-4; DeepSeek-V4 closed the gap on coding benchmarks. Meta's Llama 4 open weights sparked industry-wide adoption debates.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems and that DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level. New NIST guidelines target multi-agent systems.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: NVIDIA Blackwell ramp hits volume production; Google and Microsoft announce major data center expansions in Texas and Arizona. TSMC reports record AI chip orders.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will the first AGI system emerge from a closed lab or an open-weight coalition by 2028?
